pop_mye.note: ONS mid-year estimates (Nomis NM_2002_1) copied for LA, East of England and England; the Bedfordshire total is the sum of the three LA values, and the 16-19 and 25-64 bands are sums of published cells.

pop_snpp.note: ONS 2022-based subnational population projections (Nomis NM_2006_1) copied for LA, region and England; the Bedfordshire total sums the three LAs and the 16-19 band sums four single years.

aps.note: Annual Population Survey rates, counts and confidence intervals copied from Nomis NM_17_5, plus ONS model-based unemployment from NM_127_1; estimates Nomis flags unreliable are nulled, and no Bedfordshire total is produced.

claimant.note: Claimant counts are copied from Nomis NM_162_1 for LA, region and England and summed for Bedfordshire; every claimant rate, at every level including region and England, is computed here with ONS mid-year population denominators.

ashe_res.note: ASHE median pay copied from Nomis NM_30_1 (residence) and NM_99_1 (workplace); only the confidence interval is derived here from the published coefficient of variation, and there is no Bedfordshire total.

bres_sectors.note: BRES employee counts are copied from Nomis NM_189_1 for LA, region and England and summed for Bedfordshire; sector shares and location quotients are computed here at every level from those rounded counts.

jobs_density.note: Total jobs and jobs density are copied from Nomis NM_57_1 for LA, region and England; the Bedfordshire total jobs are summed and its density is computed here.

census_age_activity.note: Cells come from the ONS Census 2021 custom-dataset API (economic_activity_status_12a by resident_age_6a/7a) for LA, region and England, but every published figure here is built by summing status categories and/or age bands, percentages are computed here, and Bedfordshire sums the three LAs.

census_od.note: Census 2021 origin-destination flows (ODWP01EW LTLA bulk file) are copied pair by pair for each LA, but totals, the 'all other areas' remainder, net commuting and percentages are calculated, and Bedfordshire rows aggregate the three LAs as one area; there are no region or England rows.

census_lsoa.note: Census 2021 TS066/TS067/TS039/TS038/TS007 cells are copied from Nomis at LSOA, LA, region and England level; several counts sum categories, all percentages are computed here, and Bedfordshire sums the three LA rows.

pop_lsoa.note: ONS small-area mid-year estimates (Nomis NM_2014_1) are copied at LSOA level; LA and Bedfordshire rows are sums of the LSOAs, and the 16-19 and 25-64 bands are sums of published cells.

claimant_lsoa.note: Claimant counts are copied from Nomis NM_162_1 at LSOA (latest month) and at LA, region and England (24 months) and summed for Bedfordshire; rates are computed here for LSOA, LA and Bedfordshire only, with small-area population denominators.

imd2025.note: IoD2025 scores, ranks and deciles are copied from MHCLG File 7 at LSOA level; the LA and Bedfordshire rows are our own counts and shares of LSOAs in the most deprived national deciles.

census_barriers.note: Census 2021 TS045/TS029/TS003/TS037 cells are copied from Nomis at LSOA, LA, region and England; two counts sum categories, all percentages are computed here, and Bedfordshire sums the three LA rows.

geo_boundaries.note: A lineage-only dataset: we count the boundary polygons we downloaded from the ONS Open Geography Portal for each map layer; no statistic is published by the source.

dfe_neet.note: LA, East of England and England rows are copied from DfE's NEET/participation CSVs (EES data-set files a9b8ebe6, a7bc111a, e1f4011a); the Bedfordshire row is ours: counts summed across the 3 UAs and the three NEET/not-known rates recomputed from summed counts over the summed Dec-Feb average cohort, while participation-type percentages have no Bedfordshire row.

dfe_apprenticeships.note: Starts, achievements, participation, DfE's own starts-per-100,000 rate and population are copied from DfE's apprenticeships CSVs (by learner home LA, region, England and Bedford/Luton-named 2024 parliamentary constituencies as the small-area level); Bedfordshire rows are our sums of the 3 UAs' rounded counts and a starts rate recomputed from summed starts over summed population.

dfe_fe_skills.note: Values are copied from DfE's further education and skills geography CSVs (learner home LA, region, England; constituency rows are dropped); Bedfordshire rows are our sums of the 3 UAs' rounded counts, and the per-100,000 rates have no Bedfordshire row.

dfe_ks5_destinations.note: Percentages are copied from DfE's 16-18 destination measures via the EES API (data set 019d4e73-6440-7523-b60c-bfab1ad4a30d, LA of institution, region, England, by disadvantage status); the Bedfordshire row is recomputed by us as 100 x summed sustaining pupils / summed cohort of the 3 UAs.

dfe_ks4_destinations.note: Percentages are copied from DfE's Key stage 4 destination measures via the EES API (data set 019d4f41-22d1-71b2-a1a7-f3b91026815b, LA of institution, region, England, by disadvantage status); the Bedfordshire row is recomputed by us as 100 x summed sustaining pupils / summed cohort of the 3 UAs.

dfe_l2l3_19.note: Percentages and gaps are copied from DfE's Level 2 and 3 attainment by 19 CSV (data-set file 882297f8, LA of school at 15, region, England); the Bedfordshire row is recomputed by us from summed number / number_in_ss_cohort, and DfE's percentage-point gaps have no Bedfordshire row.

dfe_care_leavers.note: Activity percentages and counts are copied from DfE's care leavers activity CSV (data-set file 5279794c, responsible LA, region, England); Bedfordshire rows are ours: the care-leaver total summed across the 3 UAs and the EET/NEET rates recomputed from summed counts, with no Bedfordshire row for the per-activity breakdown.

dfe_ehcp.note: Counts come from DfE's EHC plans data set via the EES API (01a0aa37) by maintaining LA, region and England; the 'all ages' band is DfE's own total copied as is, but the 16-19 and 20-25 bands are our sums of DfE's single-year-of-age counts, and Bedfordshire is our sum of the 3 UAs.

providers.note: Provider points copy GIAS register fields (pupils on roll, % FSM) for open establishments we select and classify; the LA and Bedfordshire provider counts are ours, counting GIAS records in each category we assign.

school_pipeline.note: Year-group headcounts and secondary FSM/SEN percentages are copied from DfE school census data sets (EES API) at LA, region and England; Y7-11/Y12-13 totals and the age-16 and 16-18 cohort roll-forwards are our arithmetic at every level, and every Bedfordshire row is our sum or recomputed rate.

dfe_ks4_la.note: KS4 averages, percentages and pupil counts are copied from DfE's KS4 performance data sets via the EES API at LA, region and England; Bedfordshire rows are recomputed by us from summed numerators and pupils, and the disadvantage gap and % disadvantaged are our arithmetic at every level.

dfe_ks4_school.note: School-level KS4 results are copied as is from DfE's school performance data set via the EES API (19e39901) for schools in the 3 UAs, with coordinates joined from GIAS by URN; there are no area totals.

dfe_16_18_la.note: 16-18 attainment and retention figures are copied from DfE's 16 to 18 performance data sets via the EES API (LA of institution, region, England; England retention comes from DfE's national time series); the only Bedfordshire rows are our sums of student counts.

dfe_absence_exclusions.note: Persistent absence and suspension/exclusion rates for state-funded secondary schools are copied from DfE (absence via EES API data set 019d209c, suspensions via EES data-catalogue CSV 59d8b51e) at LA, region and England; Bedfordshire rows are recomputed by us from summed counts over summed enrolments or headcount.

affordability.note: House price to earnings ratios and private rents are copied from ONS spreadsheets at LA, region and England; the rent share of National Living Wage pay is our arithmetic, and there is no Bedfordshire total.

childcare.note: Every figure is our arithmetic on Ofsted's provider-level childcare register file (counting active Early Years Register providers and summing their places by provider LA, region and England) plus ONS mid-year population summed over single ages 0-4 from Nomis.

ofsted_fe.note: Provider rows copy each Bedfordshire FE and skills provider's legacy Ofsted grade from Ofsted's MI file, while all area counts and the good-or-outstanding share are our tallies of that provider file (LA, Bedfordshire, East of England, England).

travel_lsoa.note: LSOA journey times are our OpenTripPlanner 2.8.1 model output for one weekday (Tue 17 Nov 2026) over OSM roads, BODS bus timetables and a partly hand-built rail timetable, and the LA and Bedfordshire rows are our population-weighted shares (ONS 16-64 small-area estimates) of those modelled LSOA results.

dwp_uc.note: Counts of people on Universal Credit by conditionality regime are copied from DWP Stat-Xplore UC_Monthly tables at LA, region, England and LSOA21 (MSOA21 fallback); Bedfordshire is our sum of the 3 UAs, planning+preparing is our sum of two regimes and the no-work-requirements rate is ours (the fetcher has not yet run, so dwp_uc.json does not exist).

bres_share_land_transport.method: BRES employees in industry 146800689 (division 49) / BRES employees in all industries (Nomis NM_189_1) x 100, from rounded published counts.

bres_lq_land_transport.method: Location quotient: (area employees in industry 146800689 (division 49) / area all-industry employees) / (England employees in that industry / England all-industry employees), from rounded Nomis NM_189_1 counts.

bres_emp_air.method: BRES employees, Nomis NM_189_1 industry 146800691 (division 51), copied as published (rounded); BEDS = sum of the 3 LAs.

bres_share_air.method: BRES employees in industry 146800691 (division 51) / BRES employees in all industries (Nomis NM_189_1) x 100, from rounded published counts.

bres_lq_air.method: Location quotient: (area employees in industry 146800691 (division 51) / area all-industry employees) / (England employees in that industry / England all-industry employees), from rounded Nomis NM_189_1 counts.

bres_emp_wholesale.method: BRES employees, Nomis NM_189_1 industry 146800686 (division 46), copied as published (rounded); BEDS = sum of the 3 LAs.

bres_share_wholesale.method: BRES employees in industry 146800686 (division 46) / BRES employees in all industries (Nomis NM_189_1) x 100, from rounded published counts.

jobs_total.method: ONS total jobs, Nomis NM_57_1 item 1, copied as published; BEDS = sum of the 3 LAs.

census_pop.method: Sum of all 11 economic_activity_status_12a categories for the age band (ONS Census 2021 custom-dataset API), with composite bands 25-64, 16-64 and 18-24 also summed across age bands; BEDS = sum of the 3 LAs.

census_employed.method: Sum of Census 2021 economic_activity_status_12a categories 1, 2, 3 and 5 (the in-employment categories) for the age band (ONS custom-dataset API), composite age bands summed; BEDS = sum of the 3 LAs.

census_unemployed.method: Sum of Census 2021 TS066 categories 7 + 14 (unemployed excl. and incl. full-time students), via Nomis, at each geography; BEDS = sum of the 3 LAs.

census_inact_total.method: Sum of Census 2021 economic_activity_status_12a inactive categories 7-11 for the age band (ONS custom-dataset API), composite age bands summed; BEDS = sum of the 3 LAs.

census_inact_retired.method: Census 2021 economic_activity_status_12a category 7 (retired) from the ONS custom-dataset API: copied as is for the single age bands, but summed by us for the composite bands 25-64, 16-64 and 18-24; BEDS = sum of the 3 LAs.

census_inact_student.method: Census 2021 economic_activity_status_12a category 8 (student) from the ONS custom-dataset API: copied as is for the single age bands, but summed by us for the composite bands 25-64, 16-64 and 18-24; BEDS = sum of the 3 LAs.

census_inact_home_family.method: Census 2021 economic_activity_status_12a category 9 (looking after home or family) from the ONS custom-dataset API: copied as is for the single age bands, but summed by us for the composite bands 25-64, 16-64 and 18-24; BEDS = sum of the 3 LAs.

census_inact_lt_sick.method: Census 2021 economic_activity_status_12a category 10 (long-term sick or disabled) from the ONS custom-dataset API: copied as is for the single age bands, but summed by us for the composite bands 25-64, 16-64 and 18-24; BEDS = sum of the 3 LAs.

census_inact_other.method: Census 2021 economic_activity_status_12a category 11 (other) from the ONS custom-dataset API: copied as is for the single age bands, but summed by us for the composite bands 25-64, 16-64 and 18-24; BEDS = sum of the 3 LAs.

census_inact_total_pct.method: census_inact_total / census_pop (sum of all 11 status categories) for the same age band x 100, from ONS Census 2021 custom-dataset API cells; BEDS from summed counts.

census_inact_retired_pct.method: census_inact_retired / census_pop (sum of all 11 status categories) for the same age band x 100, from ONS Census 2021 custom-dataset API cells; BEDS from summed counts.

census_inact_student_pct.method: census_inact_student / census_pop (sum of all 11 status categories) for the same age band x 100, from ONS Census 2021 custom-dataset API cells; BEDS from summed counts.

census_inact_home_family_pct.method: census_inact_home_family / census_pop (sum of all 11 status categories) for the same age band x 100, from ONS Census 2021 custom-dataset API cells; BEDS from summed counts.

census_inact_lt_sick_pct.method: census_inact_lt_sick / census_pop (sum of all 11 status categories) for the same age band x 100, from ONS Census 2021 custom-dataset API cells; BEDS from summed counts.

od_inflow_by_residence.method: Top-25 rows are published ODWP01EW LTLA flows (place-of-work category 3) into the focus LA by residence LA, copied as is; the 'all other areas' row is our remainder (total minus top 25) and BEDS rows sum flows into all 3 LAs.

od_outflow_by_workplace.method: Top-25 rows are published ODWP01EW LTLA flows (category 3) from the focus LA by workplace LA, copied as is; the 'all other areas' row is our remainder and BEDS rows sum flows out of all 3 LAs.

od_workplace_commuters.method: Sum of all ODWP01EW category-3 flows whose workplace is in the focus area (any residence).

od_resident_commuters.method: Sum of all ODWP01EW category-3 flows from residents of the focus area to any UK workplace.

od_home_or_no_fixed_place.method: ODWP01EW place-of-work category 1 (mainly at or from home) count for the residence LA, copied as published; BEDS = sum of the 3 LAs.

od_net_commuting.method: od_workplace_commuters minus od_resident_commuters, from summed ODWP01EW flows.

od_self_containment_pct.method: Residents working in the same area (ODWP01EW within-area flows) / od_resident_commuters x 100; for BEDS, within-area means any of the 3 LAs.

od_jobs_filled_by_incommuters_pct.method: (od_workplace_commuters minus within-area flows) / od_workplace_commuters x 100, from ODWP01EW flows.

ofsted_fe_grade_count.method: Our count of providers in the Ofsted further education and skills inspections MI state file by 'Latest overall effectiveness before renewed EIF' grade (plus 'no graded inspection'), by area.

ofsted_fe_pct_good_plus.method: Our share: providers with legacy grade 1 or 2 / providers with any legacy grade 1-4 x 100, from our counts.

ofsted_fe_rc_count.method: Our count of providers in each area with at least one renewed-EIF report-card inspection in the Ofsted further education and skills inspections MI inspections CSV.

tt_pt_am_min.method: OTP public transport + walk model, shortest itinerary from the LSOA 2021 population-weighted centroid to the Kempston Hardwick site (52.0898, -0.4996) arriving 07:30-08:30, over BODS registered bus timetables (south_east, east_anglia, east_midlands, cut to trips on the day touching a Bedfordshire box) and the rail GTFS; approximations: Rail inputs (pipeline/travel/make_rail_gtfs.py and rail_gtfs/): Marston Vale Bedford-Bletchley Mon-Fri trains transcribed train by train from LNR's 18 May-11 Dec 2026 PDF; Thameslink Bedford-Luton Airport Parkway modelled as fixed headways (frequencies.txt, exact_times=1) with one fixed running-time template per direction (every 15 min by day, every 30 min southbound after 22:14, every 15 min northbound 23:10-24:56); EMR Connect Bedford-Luton-Luton Airport Parkway modelled as 30-min headways plus two single late southbound trips; peak fast Thameslink and all other rail (East Coast Main Line Sandy/Biggleswade/Arlesey, Midland Main Line beyond these stations) omitted; walk 1.33 m/s, 2-min transfer slack, access/egress walk max 45 min, walk-only answers capped at 60 min.

tt_pt_late_min.method: OTP public transport model, minutes from leaving the site at 22:30 until earliest arrival at the LSOA centroid (null if not home by 00:30), same bus/rail inputs and the same rail approximations (Rail inputs (pipeline/travel/make_rail_gtfs.py and rail_gtfs/): Marston Vale Bedford-Bletchley Mon-Fri trains transcribed train by train from LNR's 18 May-11 Dec 2026 PDF; Thameslink Bedford-Luton Airport Parkway modelled as fixed headways (frequencies.txt, exact_times=1) with one fixed running-time template per direction (every 15 min by day, every 30 min southbound after 22:14, every 15 min northbound 23:10-24:56); EMR Connect Bedford-Luton-Luton Airport Parkway modelled as 30-min headways plus two single late southbound trips; peak fast Thameslink and all other rail (East Coast Main Line Sandy/Biggleswade/Arlesey, Midland Main Line beyond these stations) omitted).

tt_pt_late_ok_pct.method: LSOA: 100 if the modelled late journey home (tt_pt_late_min) is 90 min or less, else 0; LA and Bedfordshire: our share of residents aged 16-64 (ONS small-area estimates, pop_lsoa popsa_16_64) living in LSOAs where it is 100.

tt_car_min.method: OTP car routing from the LSOA 2021 population-weighted centroid to the Kempston Hardwick site (52.0898, -0.4996) on the Geofabrik Bedfordshire OSM extract with UK tag-mapping free-flow road speeds: no congestion, junction delay or parking.

tt_cycle_min.method: OTP bicycle routing from the LSOA 2021 population-weighted centroid to the Kempston Hardwick site (52.0898, -0.4996) on OSM at a flat 5 m/s (18 km/h), ignoring hills and route quality.

tt_walk_min.method: OTP walk routing from the LSOA 2021 population-weighted centroid to the Kempston Hardwick site (52.0898, -0.4996) on OSM at 1.33 m/s.

tt_pop1664_pt45_pct.method: Our share of residents aged 16-64 (ONS small-area estimates via pop_lsoa) living in LSOAs whose modelled tt_pt_am_min is 45 min or less, by UA and Bedfordshire.

tt_pop1664_pt60_pct.method: Our share of residents aged 16-64 living in LSOAs whose modelled tt_pt_am_min is 60 min or less, by UA and Bedfordshire.

tt_pop1664_car30_pct.method: Our share of residents aged 16-64 living in LSOAs whose modelled free-flow tt_car_min is 30 min or less, by UA and Bedfordshire.

uc_nwr_rate.method: Our rate: uc_nwr / ONS population aged 16-64 x 100 (pop_mye for LA/region/England/Bedfordshire, pop_lsoa small-area estimates for LSOA/MSOA; nearest mid-year at or before the month).
